components.name: Tray states
components.description: SVG previews of the 64-pixel Pillow icon source. Windows controls the displayed tray size; state tooltips accompany the icon.

narrative.overview: Neutral dark gray surfaces, white text and restrained teal and blue accents. The designed Windows surface is the Recent dictations popup and its tray icon. The separate macOS implementation is headless; this document does not prescribe a macOS screen.
dos: Do retain the neutral palette, system type and restrained state colors.
Do keep every transcript and the full-log action reachable when the popup exceeds the work area.
Do preserve full transcript text behind shortened previews.
donts: Don't add personal brand colors, decorative marketing imagery or an unrelated product flow.
Don't treat screenshots, keyboard shortcuts or system-DPI tests as full accessibility or mixed-DPI hardware certification.
